descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Inginerie robotică
300 million people need your skills to change their lives. 
 For thousands of years, blind individuals have relied on two mobility solutions: the guide dog and the white cane. Now, Physical AI is changing that.
 At .lumen, we build Physical AI for Mobility , powering everything from Glasses for the Blind to humanoid and quadruped robots. Your work will help these technologies navigate the real world autonomously, changing how people and robots move.
 This is for the crazy ones, the ones who believe their work can change the world.
 Some of the fields of interest: 
 · Design, implement, and execute a plethora of test cases, pushing our Physical AI software and robotic systems to their limits.
 · Collaborate with your development team to intentionally break their work, ask them to fix it, and then break it some more.
 · Act as a gatekeeper of product quality, functionality, and reliability.
 · Go out and test our products "in the wild", in real-life conditions, from busy streets to complex indoor environments.
 · Explore advanced testing technologies, including robotics simulation, ROS testing, and automated testing frameworks.
 Your skills 
 First and foremost, curiosity and grit. You'll be testing technology at the cutting edge of Physical AI and robotics, pushing the limits of what's possible.
 · Experience testing embedded and/or object-oriented software.
 · Knowledge of Python and/or C++.
 · Software versioning, ideally Git.
 · Thorough understanding of the software development life cycle.
 · Good Linux skills.
 · Experience with ROS/ROS 2, robotics simulation, or autonomous systems is a plus.
 · A hands-on, proactive attitude and a desire to challenge things and suggest improvements.
 · Strong documentation skills for test reports and issues.
 · Technical university graduate or equivalent experience.
 · Strong English skills.
 Your life @.lumen 
 You will be part of the team changing the world, from Romania. Your work will push the boundaries of Physical AI, improving people's lives and enabling robots to navigate the world.
 · Each day is different. No monotony, just great challenges, a creative environment, and fun colleagues.
 · Your work will be used in days, not years.
 · You'll work within a small team, complementing each other.
 · You'll receive a lot of support. With time, we hope to see you do the same.
 Otherwise, we have a nice IKEA showroom-like HQ, good coffee, and loud music (but some quiet areas too).
 We are rooted in flexibility. For us, "hybrid" means that you create your own schedule, but we spend time together in our Cluj office.
 What else we offer? 
 · Attractive salary (obviously…)
 · Employee Stock Option Program rewarding significant impact with company stock
 · Private medical package
 · Flexible schedule
 What's next? 
 Our recruitment process includes 4 steps:
 1. We review your application.
 2. The most suited candidates meet us for an informal discussion.
 3. Next, we invite the best to join a challenge led by Octavian Coca.
 4. We meet the winner for a final interview with Cornel Amariei.
 About .lumen 
 ﻿Over 300 million visually impaired individuals worldwide still rely on mobility solutions that have existed for generations: guide dogs and white canes. We set out to change that.
 We started with Glasses for the Blind, developing AI that understands the environment and enables people to navigate independently.
 But Glasses for the Blind were just the beginning. 
 The same technology can enable humanoid and quadruped robots to autonomously navigate complex environments, indoors and outdoors. We are now bringing Physical AI to autonomous mobility and robotic delivery.
 .lumen is a deep-tech startup combining advanced AI, computer vision, and robotics to solve some of the hardest challenges in autonomous mobility. We are looking for the best in the world to help us.
 In just five years, .lumen has become one of the most awarded startups globally. From opening NVIDIA GTC in front of millions to winning the Red Dot: Luminary award and raising over €9 million from the European Innovation Council (EIC), our journey has been remarkable.
 Our work is already in the history books, and our story is still being written.
 Come write it with us. 
 Also, check out our video: https://youtu.be/Im-Gsn5PKG8?si=-6GcseGllk1HJYxc
